management_steps.details: Used for fluid resuscitation in cholera, severe dehydration (Plan C: 20 mL/kg rapidly, then 20 mL/kg every hour for 5 hours), and severe dysentery dehydration.
Preferred IV fluid for cholera. Avoid giving calcium-containing IV fluids together with ceftriaxone.

warnings: Avoid giving calcium-containing IV fluids (e.g. Ringers Lactate) together with ceftriaxone in neonates <= 28 days for 48 hours after ceftriaxone administration.
